_readme: Missions, their order and their objectives for CampaignState (autoload). Owned by Fahd.
IDs are lowercase with dots. A mission is mN, an objective is mN.thing. Objective IDs are unique across all missions.
objectives: all required for mission_completed. optional_objectives: can be completed but do not count.
objective_titles: what the console and the rover HUD show for each objective. report: the lines the console's Downlink tab shows once the mission's data is sent.

guidance: per objective, the ordered steps the guidance tracker shows (Guidance, src/levels/guidance.gd). A step: text, label (the name over the highlighted target), target (path:<from the level root>, group:<group>, scan:<target_id>, kite:<Robot property>[/<child path>]), key (an input action), stuck (shown after 45 s), waypoint (on-screen marker while driving) and done_when (all must hold: state / not_state (GameState names), holding_part (part type), mounted (socket target), near + distance (Kite to the target, m), view (rover camera view), console_section). The current step is the one after the last met step; a step without done_when stays until the objective completes. Guidance never completes objectives. complete_guidance: shown once the mission is complete.
legacy_id: the id the same mission has in docs/examples/MISSIONS.json (the save metadata still uses those).
Wording and order follow game/docs/STORY_SCRIPT.md. New IDs go here; tell the group in the chat.

missions.title: Wake Kite

objective_titles.m1.iris_scanned: Scan IRIS's service panel with the mast camera
objective_titles.m1.kite_docked: Return Kite to the charging pad
objective_titles.m1.inspection_sent: Downlink the inspection from the console

report: J1 RADIO PWR: no supply. The radio-power module has failed.
J2 DATA: intact. Stored observations readable.
Next: fit a replacement radio-power module (M2).

m1.kite_prepared.text: Pick up a battery from the parts rack
m1.kite_prepared.label: Battery
m1.kite_prepared.stuck: The rack is the shelving on the bay's wall. Look at the battery and press E.

m1.kite_prepared.text: Drop the battery into Kite's rear battery socket
m1.kite_prepared.label: Battery socket
m1.kite_prepared.stuck: Walk to Kite's rear, look at the glowing box and press E to let go of the battery over it.

m1.iris_scanned.label: Mission console
m1.iris_scanned.stuck: The console is behind the glass partition, facing the bay. Look at it and press E.

m1.iris_scanned.text: Press CONTROL KITE on the console

m1.iris_scanned.label: IRIS
m1.iris_scanned.stuck: Follow the marker. IRIS is about 150 m from the base, past the marker posts.

m1.iris_scanned.text: Hold the crosshair on IRIS's service panel
m1.iris_scanned.label: Service panel
m1.iris_scanned.stuck: Aim at the glowing panel on IRIS's front, below the antenna, and keep still until the scan reaches 100%. Headlights: L.

m1.kite_docked.label: Mission console
m1.kite_docked.stuck: Kite is still out at IRIS. Open the console and press CONTROL KITE to drive it back.

m1.kite_docked.text: Press CONTROL KITE on the console
Drive back onto the charging pad and stop
m1.kite_docked.label: Charging pad
m1.kite_docked.stuck: Follow the marker into the bay. The dock hint at the top tells you how far to go; stop when it says Charging.

m1.inspection_sent.label: Mission console
m1.inspection_sent.stuck: Look at the console and press E.
Downlink is the third section in the console's list on the left.
The button is under the Downlink text.

missions.complete_guidance: Mission complete. Open the console to start the next mission.

objective_titles.m2.module_loaded: Load the radio-power module onto Kite
objective_titles.m2.kite_docked: Return Kite to the charging pad
